test_aselmdb_write: test writing atomic structures to an ASE LMDB database and verify they are stored correctly
test_aselmdb_delete: test deleting entries from an ASE LMDB database and verify the count decreases correctly
test_aselmdb_randomreads: test random reads from an ASE LMDB database and verify AtomsRow objects are returned
test_update_keyvalue_pair: test updating a key-value pair on a specific row in an ASE LMDB database
test_update_atoms: test updating the atoms object for a specific row in an ASE LMDB database
